game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Exponent Engine: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: In Charred Forest, repeat each round: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy. Each round, ember hounds strike the smelter, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the engine_power value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the smelter from ember hounds in Charred Forest: keep the engine_power meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: engine_power drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Exponent Engine
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exponent Engine' (Week 2 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Charred Forest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how engine_power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Charred Forest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 29 seconds while engine_power > 0.
